00096 void UGenOutput::useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse)
00097 {
00098     if(externalOutputToUse == 0)
00099     {
00100         usingExternalOutput = false;
00101         block = 0;
00102         blockSize = 0;
00103         allocatedBlockSize = 0;
00104         externalOutput = 0;
00105     }
00106     else
00107     {
00108         if(usingExternalOutput == false)
00109             delete [] block;
00110         
00111         usingExternalOutput = true;
00112         block = 0;
00113         blockSize = 0;
00114         allocatedBlockSize = 0;
00115         externalOutput = externalOutputToUse;
00116     }
00117 }

00216 float* UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00217 {
00218     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00219     {
00220         processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00221         
00222         if(isScheduledForDeletion == false && shouldDelete == true)
00223         {
00224             isScheduledForDeletion = true;
00225             blockIDtoBeDeletedAfter = blockID;
00226         }
00227         
00228         lastBlockID = blockID;
00229     }
00230     
00231     return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00232 }

00272 int UGenInternal::findMaxInputChannels() const throw()
00273 {
00274     int numChannels = 0;
00275     
00276     for(int i = 0; i < numInputs_; i++)
00277     {
00278         int inputChannels = inputs[i].getNumChannels();
00279         if(inputChannels > numChannels)
00280             numChannels = inputChannels;
00281     }
00282     
00283     return numChannels;
00284 }

00286 void UGenInternal::getInternalChannels(const int channel, UGenInternal** internals) throw()
00287 {
00288     for(int i = 0; i < numInputs_; i++)
00289     {
00290         internals[i] = getInput(i, channel);

00294 UGenInternal* UGenInternal::getInput(const int inputIndex, const int channel) throw()
00295 {
00296     if(inputIndex < 0 || inputIndex >= numInputs_) return 0;
00297     
00298     UGen& input = inputs[inputIndex];
00299     return input.getInternalUGen(channel % input.getNumChannels());

00309 ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(const int numInputs, const int numProxies) throw()
00310 :   UGenInternal(numInputs),
00311     numProxies_(numProxies < 0 ? 0 : numProxies), // numProxies_ shouldn't be less than 0 but MixArray was sending -1 when its input was empty
00312     proxies(new UGenInternal*[numProxies_+1])
00313 {
00314     proxies[0] = this;
00315     for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00316     {
00317         proxies[i] = new ProxyUGenInternal(this, i);
00318     }
00319 }

00341 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::deleteIfOnlyMutualReferencesRemain() throw()
00342 {
00343     if(getRefCount() > numProxies_) return; 
00344     
00345     for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00346     {
00347         if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() > 1) return;
00348     }
00349     
00350     for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00351     {
00352         UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(proxies[i]);
00353     }
00354     
00355     active = false;
00356     UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(this);
00357 }

00359 UGenInternal* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::getProxy(const int index) throw()
00360 {
00361     // indices are between 0 and numProxies_ (0 is the owner)
00362     if(index < 0 || index > numProxies_) return 0;
00363     
00364     proxies[index]->incrementRefCount();
00365     return proxies[index];
00366 }

00368 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00369 {
00370     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00371     {
00372         UGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00373         
00374         for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00375         {
00376             // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00377             // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00378             if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00379                 proxies[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00380         }   
00381     }
00382 }
00383 
00384 
00385 float* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00386 {
00387     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00388     {
00389         for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00390         {
00391             // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00392             // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00393             if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00394                 proxies[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00395         }
00396 
00397         UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00398         
00399     }
00400     
00401     return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00402 }
